name: Lens over a thumbnail stream
look: A held strip of colour thumbnails grouped by project slides left under an unseen lens, and every picture near it swells and heaps into a collage of its project before sinking back, project one already open on the first frame, while a masthead caption relays letter by letter to name the project under the lens, with its year and category beside it. It turns a whole archive or portfolio into one scrubbable index with the detail view built in.
reduced: The finished composition: the markup as the page writes it, nothing moving.
phone: The same index with a fixed lens in the centre and the strip doing the travel, six pictures a project; hold about 4.4 for eight projects.
place: In the middle, on the work, the archive or the catalogue, where a grid of project cards would otherwise go.
content: Five or six projects of five to ten pictures each, 25-60 in all (five hold about three screens: set {"hold":3}, since the file's own clamp starts at four; each project more adds about 0.6): one landscape key picture a project (about 960px wide) and the rest in mixed orientations (480-640px on the long side), each with its real width and height, never cropped. They are the client's own: its work, its collection, its products. Per project a name of 1-2 words, a year (shown in the caption's meta row), a category of 2-3 words and a link; a section title of 2-3 words and a line with the range of years. With fewer than five projects, use a plain index instead.
options: hold clamp(0.62 a project, 4, 7.5) (2-10); phoneHold clamp(0.55 a project, 3.5, 6.5) (2-10); phone 'same' (a fixed lens in the centre) | 'rest' (the contact sheet); sweep 0.5 (0-0.6) share of the width the line travels, 0 a fixed lens; bloom 10 (4-10) the key picture's height in bloom units; phoneBloom 9 (4-10); reach 0.45 (0.15-0.8; phone 0.7) the lens radius; gate 0.35 (0.15-1): 0.15 one collage at a time, 1 two always mix; push 0.35 (-0.55 dense to 0.35 roomy; phone -0.55); dwell 0.7 (0-0.9) how much the strip slows at each project; seed 0, reshuffles the collages; scrub 0.6, locked with Lenis.
